page.layout: One page of running text with marginal notes at the right. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: auspicatur. {§}Benius de Grat.& lib. Arbit. cap. 18.num.13.Quòd si Augustinus dicit (inquit) Epist. 105. fidem impetrare posse remissionem peccatorum: Et rursus Epist. 106. Posse nos per fidem mereri Gratiam bene operandi.— Ego sanè possem ad eundem Augustinum sexcentis in locis provocare; in quibus tuetur, Justificationem ullo planè nostro prævio Merito non modo non inchoari, sed nè absolvi quidem: ut Epist. 105. Qua igitur sua merita jactaturus est Liberatus? qui, si digna suis meritis redderentur, non esset nisi damnatus.— Huic Patrum sententiæ Conciliorum multorum posset addi sensus & irrefragabile judicium. Etiam Concil. Trident. Sess.6. cap.8. explicans illud Apostoli, [Justificati gratis] Gratis quidem ideo justificamur (inquit) quia nihil eorum, quæ justificationem præcedunt, sive fides, sive opera, ipsam justificationis gratiam promeretur — alioquin, ut idem Apostolus, Gratia non esset Gratia. Pòst arguit, Arbitramur hoc demonstrari posse, quia ante habitualis Charitatis adeptionem, adhuc sumus filii iræ. Hæc ille, & nonnulla alia in eandem sententiam. Sed plura Testimonia accumulare supervacaneum erit.

page.notes: Only one marginal note, at top right, marked §. The leading marks before "Qua igitur" and "Arbitramur" look like ornamental section marks, not reference marks, and are left out; they are uncertain. Italic and roman boundaries in the long paragraph are read from the scan and may be slightly off. "Benius" in the note is read as printed and may be a misreading. Faint show-through text from the other side of the leaf is ignored. The running head is read as "Sect 2." and the "2." may be slightly different in the original.
